state.project: MEAG: Dresden - Lagrange Primary 230kV Upgrade & Jumpers
state.description: MEAG will re-sag the Dresden - LaGrange Primary 230kV line to 125C. Replace the jumpers at Dresden and LaGrange with (2) 1590 AAC jumpers.

q.instructions: Is this OpenStreetMap substation the endpoint the filing names?
